style.prompt: Design a polished portrait event flyer for a printmakers' open studio, authentic handcrafted printmaking aesthetic. The only text on the poster must be the exact headline: "PRINTMAKERS' OPEN STUDIO". Make this headline large, beautifully legible, and dominant in expressive bold hand-set woodblock typography arranged across three lines in the upper half. Two-color linocut and risograph-inspired print on warm ivory textured paper: rich black and vivid vermilion red, subtle ink grain and slight registration imperfections. In the middle and lower portion, create striking graphic linocut illustrations of a printmaking brayer, carved lino block, ink marks and a hand pulling a printed sheet, arranged with sophisticated editorial composition. Generous margins, high contrast, strong negative space. Reserve a clean unprinted ivory area along the bottom for future event details, but do not render placeholders or invent dates, locations, prices or any other words. Finished graphic design, flat poster artwork filling frame, no mockup, no wall, no watermark.
